hypothesis: The REMAINING post-scroll TUI retention census-documented by tui-memory's merged #2895 record (+65MB RSS after a 2600-key PageUp walk at 10MiB, fully retained at tail) is live span-fragmented entry_layout row storage, not allocator slack; it is dominated by per-span Vec/String chunk overhead (the text is a small fraction of it), so storing the cached rows PACKED (one content blob + dense (offset,len,style) records, byte-exact range expansion) should cut the retained heap ~60-70% with byte-identical output on every path, because merging spans instead (the -67% any-style census savings) would change the exit-flush inline scrollback's per-span SGR bytes - a frozen TS-parity stream.
approach: (1) Census first (PROBE build lane/hillclimb-tui-scroll-probe*, kick-file census of entry_layout/md_caches/entry_heights/sparse_entries + span-fragment stats + self-smaps + PA_TUI_FLUSH_DUMP byte-dump tee): walk2600 at 10MiB retains 5,428 slots / 86,437 lines / 713,761 spans (604,519 walk-added; assistant rows own 657,804 at ~10/line, alternating Style::new() and fg(Rgb(216,216,220)) per word); content 9.59MB with ZERO content-capacity slack, 44% line-buffer capacity slack; 98% of mergeable adjacent pairs are STYLED (adjacent-same default pairs only 1.9%) - merge-compaction would alter the exit-flush SGR bytes (measured: dumps are 26,941,120 bytes of per-span SGR), so the fix packs instead. Heights never cache in sparse mode (heights_some [0,0,0] all phases; no orphan heights; layout/height cross-checks clean); md_caches stay EMPTY through the walk post-#2895 (the memory lane's fix holds on scroll). Trim-kick attribution: idle_final trim frees only 0.9MB - the retention is LIVE. (2) Product change (3 files, 278 insertions): view/layout.rs gains RowPack { first: Vec<u32>, spans: Vec<PackedSpan{offset: u32, len: u32, style}>, blob: String } + EntryRows enum; EntryLayout.rows becomes Arc<RowPack>; sparse_entry_rows stores pack(&rows) (exact blob capacity via first-pass sizing) and returns EntryRows (Packed on cache hit, Fresh for transient uncacheable rows); slice_entry_rows + the sparse-walk emit loops expand ONLY the [from,to) row range (a frame inside a huge entry pays its visible rows); size-gated post-pack trim (rows >= 8192) returns the freed expanded transient to the OS (the same pa_types::memory_release plumbing as #2872/#2895; ungated ordinary entries never pay a trim). (3) Two unit oracles added: row_pack_expands_byte_exact (mixed spans incl. adjacent same-style + empty spans + blank line; every range expansion equals the original) and cached_packed_rows_render_identical_to_a_fresh_layout.
